# Prometheus-compatible

Plugin ID `prometheus`. VictoriaMetrics or Prometheus: the series behind charts, KPIs and host metrics.

dash asks a Prometheus-compatible server (VictoriaMetrics or Prometheus) for the series behind
its charts and KPIs. The plugin has no page of its own: the plugins that use it read their
metrics through it, and the charts on `/api/v1/series` query it.

## What it shows

### Pages

No page of its own.

## Dependencies

A change to a plugin's settings restarts it and the plugins that require or use it.

- **Required by** [RustFS](rustfs.md).
- **Used by** [Proxmox VE](proxmox.md), [Hardware](hardware.md), [Kubernetes](kubernetes.md) and [CloudNativePG](cnpg.md).

## Settings

Every setting is under `plugins.prometheus` in the config file and is also in the [configuration reference](../configuration.md#pluginsprometheus), with the rules for all of them: the layers, the `_FILE` form of each variable and secret references. _Restart_ marks a setting that applies only when dash restarts; a change to any other restarts the plugin in place.

| Setting | Variable | Type | Default | Secret | Restart | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `plugins.prometheus.type` | `DASH_PLUGINS_PROMETHEUS_TYPE` | string | - | no | no | The plugin type. dash runs one instance per type, so this is empty or the section name. |
| `plugins.prometheus.enabled` | `DASH_PLUGINS_PROMETHEUS_ENABLED` | boolean | - | no | no | false turns the plugin off: its topics are removed, and the web UI drops its rail entry, palette entries, overview tiles and panels and shows a switched-off page at its address. Unset turns it on when it has the settings it needs (rustfs is off unless enabled: true, because nothing in its settings says an object store exists); a plugin without them is disabled ("not configured: set plugins.<id>.url", naming the setting to make) and the web UI hides its pages. true with settings missing or invalid makes it unconfigured, which hides its pages too. This is how prometheus, alertmanager, gatus, victorialogs, proxmox, hardware, ssh, kubernetes, flux, cnpg, rustfs, grafana, headlamp and launcher behave, and a change to any of their settings applies live: that plugin restarts, and so do the plugins that use or require it (a prometheus change restarts proxmox, hardware, kubernetes, cnpg and rustfs; a gatus change restarts hardware and kubernetes; a proxmox change restarts hardware; a kubernetes change restarts proxmox, flux and cnpg; a grafana change restarts alertmanager). |
| `plugins.prometheus.url` | `DASH_PLUGINS_PROMETHEUS_URL` | string | - | no | no | Base URL of the service, e.g. http://host:9090. Empty turns the source off: dash makes no request and its panels show "source not configured". |
| `plugins.prometheus.timeout` | `DASH_PLUGINS_PROMETHEUS_TIMEOUT` | duration (e.g. 30s) | `5s` | no | no | How long one query may take before dash gives up on it. |
| `plugins.prometheus.auth.basic.username` | `DASH_PLUGINS_PROMETHEUS_AUTH_BASIC_USERNAME` | string | - | no | no | User name. |
| `plugins.prometheus.auth.basic.password` | `DASH_PLUGINS_PROMETHEUS_AUTH_BASIC_PASSWORD` | string | - | yes | no | Password: a literal, env:NAME, file:/path or k8s:<namespace>/<name>#<key> (read from that Kubernetes Secret by the kubernetes plugin, which must run and be allowed to read it). Set together with username. |
| `plugins.prometheus.auth.bearerToken` | `DASH_PLUGINS_PROMETHEUS_AUTH_BEARER_TOKEN` | string | - | yes | no | Bearer token sent as Authorization: Bearer: a literal, env:NAME, file:/path or k8s:<namespace>/<name>#<key> (read from that Kubernetes Secret by the kubernetes plugin, which must run and be allowed to read it). Not together with basic. |
| `plugins.prometheus.headers` | `DASH_PLUGINS_PROMETHEUS_HEADERS` | object (JSON) | - | no | no | Extra headers sent with every request, as {name: value}. Plain configuration, not secrets: put credentials in auth. Authorization, Proxy-Authorization, Cookie and Host cannot be set. A JSON object in the environment. |
| `plugins.prometheus.tls.caFile` | `DASH_PLUGINS_PROMETHEUS_TLS_CA_FILE` | string | - | no | no | Path of a PEM file with the certificate authority that signed the service's certificate, added to the system roots. Empty uses the system roots only. |
| `plugins.prometheus.tls.insecureSkipVerify` | `DASH_PLUGINS_PROMETHEUS_TLS_INSECURE_SKIP_VERIFY` | boolean | - | no | no | Skip verifying the service's certificate and host name. Anyone on the network path can then impersonate the service: prefer caFile. |

## Actions

None: the plugin only reads.

## Demo twin

With `DASH_DEMO=true` dash runs the plugin's demo twin instead: the same manifest, enabled and configured whatever the settings say, publishing made-up data from the fake lab in `internal/demo/world` and contacting nothing.
